name: survival-os
description: Terminal de supervivencia offline para Raspberry Pi 5 (pantalla HDMI táctil 7").

scripts.build: npm run build -w @survival-os/device-api && npm run build -w @survival-os/library && npm run build -w @survival-os/navigation && npm run build -w @survival-os/vault && npm run build -w @survival-os/esp32-gateway && npm run build -w @survival-os/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @survival-os/device-api && npm run typecheck -w @survival-os/library && npm run typecheck -w @survival-os/navigation && npm run typecheck -w @survival-os/vault && npm run typecheck -w @survival-os/esp32-gateway && npm run typecheck -w @survival-os/frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.guide: node scripts/build-emergency-guide.mjs --size a5 && node scripts/build-emergency-guide.mjs --size a4
